sections.text: مقدمة

This documents out lines the equipment inspection procedure I1, which must be 
 performed every two years or at thrust bearing damage which comes first, as indicated by Y2 in the title block.

تستخدم هذه المضخة لدفع عملية التبريد 
 الماء من خلال المبادلات الحرارية لتبريد المعدات المساعدة.

The first draft Initiated by eng. Yasser soliman Rakha, tested by eng. Abed 
 Allah Ebraeihem, revised by EDEPC inspection and quality control eng Abouda Elbana, 
 accepted by general manager eng. Mohamed Hussein, and approved by eng: Fawzy 
 Sobhy Ismaiel Abu sultan power station head sector.

This document is accepted by eng. Samir 
Abd El Gilil EDEPC MPIS coordinator, and certified by accountant; Mahmoud 
Mohamed Soliman; EDEPC admin and financial inspection, quality control General 
Director and supervisor of inspection and quality control head sector.

sections.text: Assembly of the Emergency Thrust Bearing Replacement

Clean all contact surfaces before 
 mounting.

Wipe a small amount of grease on the oil 
 seal lips in bearing housing.

Place thrust bearing housing (134) on 
 shaft, with the double locks up and slides it a long to approximately its 
 correct location.

Align locks on bearing end cover (109) 
 with the grooves in lower half-casing and rotate bearing end Cover (180) so 
 that the locks are at the bottom.

Slid thrust bearing collar (237) over 
 shaft end and Push shaft shoulder.

Apply a film of oil to the bearing seat 
 on the shaft.

Install the thrust bearing (112) on the 
 shaft (the bearing will be installed back to back)

Place snap ring (361) on the shaft 
 groove.

Screw bolt bearing end cover (109) to 
 bearing housing

Tighten the nuts evenly.

sections.text: التحديق في المضخة
Before the starting Pump, the Following Steps must be Checked:

التحقق من اتجاه دوران 
 مضخة.

Open the cooling water to each gland and 
 the quantity of water is sufficient.

يتحقق من مستوى الزيت في مستوى ثابت 
 مزيتة لتحمل التوجه.

تحضير المضخة عن طريق الشفط المفتوح 
 صمام، أغلق صمام التفريغ وصمام التنفيس المفتوح حتى يتم طرد جميع الهواء و 
 يتدفق الماء من خلال الفتح.

Open the delivery valve gradually after 
 the pump has been started to operate at its full speed.
